name: zcode-plugin
description: Personal ZCode plugin collection: git-workflow (conventional commits), dev-workflow (development flow skills), guardrails (safety hooks) and websearch (keyless multi-engine search).

plugins.name: git-workflow
plugins.description: Conventional commit workflow: /gcommit generates spec-compliant commit messages, /gpr writes PR descriptions, /gchangelog builds changelogs; a PostToolUse hook checks the message after each commit.

plugins.name: dev-workflow
plugins.description: Daily development workflow: 7 flow skills (change-plan, debug, test-changed, review, commit-review, release-check, doc-gen), task-level plan files under .devflow and docs/plans, /handoff session contract persistence, a SessionStart repo snapshot, and 23 specialist subagents auto-installed into ~/.zcode/agents.

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Deterministic safety hooks: blocks irreversible shell commands (POSIX, cmd.exe and PowerShell) and hardcoded credentials, routes publishing, deploys and migrations to a confirmation prompt.

plugins.name: websearch
plugins.description: Multi-engine web search for ZCode as a zero-dependency MCP server: AnySearch, Exa, Parallel, Bing and SearXNG chained with automatic fallback, plus a static page reader. Every engine works without a key. Configuration (engine order, per-engine keys) is websearch.json inside the plugin data folder — created automatically on first use, and the tools report its exact path, so just ask the model for the websearch config location.

description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode 独立网页搜索：零依赖 MCP server，AnySearch / Exa / Parallel / Bing / SearXNG 自动回退，另带静态网页正文读取；所有引擎免 Key 可用。配置（引擎顺序、各引擎 Key）写在插件数据目录的 websearch.json——首次使用自动生成，装好后直接问模型「websearch 配置在哪」即可拿到具体路径。

plugins.name: model-speed
plugins.description: Show the current model's output speed (tokens/s) in the composer toolbar, scoped per session, using ZCode's built-in generation metrics. No API key, no network, no telemetry.

description_i18n.en: Show the current model's output speed (tokens/s) in the composer toolbar, scoped per session, using ZCode's built-in generation metrics. No API key, no network, no telemetry.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 在输入框工具栏显示当前模型的输出速度（tokens/s），按会话区分，数据来自 ZCode 内置生成指标。不需要 API Key、不发网络请求、无遥测。
